name: RC-B10-0520/2026 - Après le considérant F - Am 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting EU cities’ candidacies to host a new United Nations pillar for the independent assessment and ethical governance of AI
part_text: Fa. whereas the Radegonda Project represents a valuable initiative aimed at establishing an international reference point within the UN framework for the independent evaluation and ethical governance of AI, based on shared criteria and accessible to all states;
